chapterInfo.content:
66
Nyaatwomfoɔ asotwe
1 # 1 Ah 8.27; Aso 7.49; 17.24 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Ɔsoro yɛ m’adwa,
na asase yɛ me nan ntiasoɔ;
ɛdan bɛn na mobɛsi ama me,
na ɛhe na me homebea wɔ?
2 # Yes 57.15 Na yeinom nyinaa, me nsa na ɛyɛeɛ,
saa nti yeinom nyinaa yɛ me dea,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
Na deɛ mɛhwɛ no nie:
Deɛ ɔbrɛ ne ho aseɛ, na ne honhom abubuo,
na ne ho popo m’asɛm ano.
3 # Lew 17.14 Deɛ ɔkum nantwie no te sɛ deɛ ɔkum nipa;
deɛ ɔkum odwan bɔ afɔdeɛ no te sɛ deɛ ɔbu ɔkraman kɔn mu;
deɛ ɔbɔ aduane afɔdeɛ no te sɛ deɛ ɔde prako mogya ba;
deɛ ɔhye ohwamfufuo no te sɛ deɛ ɔhyira ohoni.
Wɔn deɛ, wɔayi wɔn akwan,
na wɔn kra ani sɔ wɔn akyiwadeɛ;
4 # Yes 65.12 me nso mɛyi amaneɛ bi mama wɔn,
na mede deɛ wɔsuro aba wɔn so,
ɛfiri sɛ mefrɛe, na obiara annye so,
mekasae, na wɔantie,
na wɔyɛɛ m’ani so bɔne,
na deɛ mempɛ no na wɔyiiɛ.
Awieeɛ berɛ no mu nkwagyeɛ
5 # Luka 6.22 Montie AWURADE asɛm,
mo a n’asɛm nti mo ho popoɔ:
Mo nuanom a wɔtane mo
a me din nti wɔtu mo no
ka sɛ: AWURADE nnya animuonyam
na yɛnhunu mo anigyeɛ;
nanso wɔn na wɔn ani bɛwu.
6Montie oo, ɛnne bi firi kuro no mu!
Ɛnne bi firi asɔrefie!
AWURADE a ɔtua n’atamfo nneyɛɛ
so ka no nne!
7Ɔnnya nkyemeeɛ no,
na wawo;
awoɔyea nnya nkaa no no,
na wawo ɔbabarima.
8Hwan na wate yei bi pɛn?
Hwan na wahunu yei bi da?
Wɔkyem wo asase da koro, anaasɛ wɔwo ɔman prɛko?
Ɛfiri sɛ awoɔ kaa Sion ara pɛ
na ɔwoo ne mma.
9 # Yes 37.3 Me, mɛma wɔabue awotwaa ano, na meremma wɔnwo?
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
Anaa, me a mema wɔwoɔ no, mɛsi ano anaa?
Wo Nyankopɔn na ɔseɛ.
10 # Dwom 122.6 Mo ne Yerusalem ani nnye, na monni ne ho ahurisie,
mo a modɔ no nyinaa;
mo ne ne ho nsɛpɛ mo,
mo a modi ne ho abooboo nyinaa;
11na moanum
n’awerɛkyekyerɛ nufoɔ amee,
na moafe n’animuonyam mmorosoɔ
ama mo bo atɔ mo yam.
12 # Yes 60.4 Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Hwɛ, merekoa yiedie mama no, sɛ asubɔnten,
ne amanaman ahonyadeɛ nso, sɛ asutene a ayire,
na moanom. Nkyɛnmu na wɔbɛturu mo,
na wɔagyegye mo anankoroma so.
13Sɛ obi na kyekyere ne werɛ no,
saa ara na me nso mɛkyekyere mo werɛ,
na mo werɛ akyekyere wɔ Yerusalem.
14Na mobɛhunu na mo akoma ho asɛpɛ no,
na mo nnompe ayɛ hurohuro sɛ wira frɔmfrɔm;
na wɔbɛhunu AWURADE nsa, ne nkoa so,
ne abufuo a emu yɛ den, n’atamfo so.
Awaefoɔ atemmuo ne wɔn a wɔahweteɛ no saneba
15 # Adi 19.11-15 Na hwɛ, AWURADE de ogya
ne ne nteaseɛnam a ɛte sɛ ahum bɛba,
de abufuhyeɛ abɛtua n’abufuo so ka,
na ɔde gyaframa ayɛ n’ateatea.
16Na ogya na AWURADE de bɛbu atɛn,
na ɔde afena ne honam nyinaa adi,
na wɔn a AWURADE bɛhwire wɔn mu bɛdɔɔso.
17 # Yes 65.4-5 Wɔn a wɔte wɔn ho dwira wɔn ho kɔ nturo mu, na wɔdi ɔbaakofoɔ a ɔdi mfimfini akyire, na wɔdi prakonam ne akyiwadeɛ ne nkura no, wɔbɛbom awie sa, AWURADE asɛm nie.
18Na menim wɔn nneyɛɛ ne wɔn adwene, na ɛbɛba sɛ mɛboa amanaman ne kasa ahodoɔ nyinaa ano, na wɔaba abɛhunu m’animuonyam. 19#Mat 28.19 Na mɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ wɔn mu, na masoma wɔn mu nnipa a wɔafiri mu afire no akɔ amanaman nkyɛn, Tarsis, Put ne Lud, taduakuntunfoɔ no, Tubal ne Yawan, nsuano aman a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri a wɔntee me nka, na wɔnhunuu m’animuonyam no, na wɔakɔka m’animuonyam amanaman no mu. 20#Yes 60.3, 7 Na wɔde mo nuanom nyinaa bɛfiri amanaman no nyinaa mu abɛyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ ama AWURADE, apɔnkɔ so ne nteaseɛnam mu ne asako mu ne mfunumupɔnkɔ ne yoma so, aba me bepɔ kronkron Yerusalem so, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, sɛdeɛ Israel mma de aduane afɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ adeɛ a emu teɛ mu ba AWURADE fie no. 21#Yes 61.6 Na mɛyi wɔn mu binom nso ayɛ asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ, AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
22 # Yes 65.17 Na sɛdeɛ ɔsoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ
a mɛyɛ no
bɛgyina m’anim no, AWURADE asɛm nie,
saa ara na mo asefoɔ ne mo din bɛgyina.
23Na ɛbɛba sɛ ɔsrane foforɔ biara
ne homeda biara
honam nyinaa bɛba abɛsɔre m’anim,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
24 # Mar 9.44 Na wɔbɛfiri adi akɔhwɛ nnipa a wɔato me mmara no afunu a wɔn mu mmoaa renwu da, na wɔn gya nso rennum da; na wɔbɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ ama honam nyinaa.

Ɔsoro yɛ m’adwa,

Na deɛ mɛhwɛ no nie:
Deɛ ɔbrɛ ne ho aseɛ, na ne honhom abubuo,
na ne ho popo m’asɛm ano.

deɛ ɔhye ohwamfufuo no te sɛ deɛ ɔhyira ohoni.

mekasae, na wɔantie,

na yɛnhunu mo anigyeɛ;

Montie oo, ɛnne bi firi kuro no mu!
Ɛnne bi firi asɔrefie!

AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
Anaa, me a mema wɔwoɔ no, mɛsi ano anaa?

Mo ne Yerusalem ani nnye, na monni ne ho ahurisie,
mo a modɔ no nyinaa;
mo ne ne ho nsɛpɛ mo,
mo a modi ne ho abooboo nyinaa;
na moanum
n’awerɛkyekyerɛ nufoɔ amee,
na moafe n’animuonyam mmorosoɔ
ama mo bo atɔ mo yam.

Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Hwɛ, merekoa yiedie mama no, sɛ asubɔnten,
ne amanaman ahonyadeɛ nso, sɛ asutene a ayire,
na moanom. Nkyɛnmu na wɔbɛturu mo,
na wɔagyegye mo anankoroma so.
Sɛ obi na kyekyere ne werɛ no,
saa ara na me nso mɛkyekyere mo werɛ,
na mo werɛ akyekyere wɔ Yerusalem.
Na mobɛhunu na mo akoma ho asɛpɛ no,
na mo nnompe ayɛ hurohuro sɛ wira frɔmfrɔm;

ne abufuo a emu yɛ den, n’atamfo so.


Na hwɛ, AWURADE de ogya

Na ogya na AWURADE de bɛbu atɛn,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
